posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia returned to Mumbai with Ranbir Kapoor after her buzzy Cannes 2026 red carpet debut, spotted at the airport wearing a 'TIRED' t-shirt amid trolling backlash. She's also confirmed for Tumbbad 3.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya reigned over Cannes 2026 with three showstopping looks — royal blue couture by Amit Aggarwal, blush pink Swarovski gown, and a white feathered pantsuit — with daughter Aaradhya by her side for her 24th festival appearance.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 became the highest-grossing Indian film ever in the UK at £4.39M and the first Hindi film to cross ₹1000 crore net. Ranveer is now in talks for a Hollywood debut with Mortal Kombat producer Lawrence Kasanoff.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is filming 'King' with daughter Suhana Khan, where she plays an assassin's apprentice to his mentor. The Siddharth Anand-directed action thriller also stars Deepika Padukone and is set for December 24, 2026.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports epic 'Peddi' releases June 4 with AR Rahman's massive Bhopal concert launching the 'Hellallallo' track. He went viral for hilariously calling Jasprit Bumrah a 'footballer' and later apologized.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun met RCB cricketer Venkatesh Iyer after an IPL 2026 match, gifting him a bouquet while Iyer gave a signed jersey to his son Ayaan. His collaboration with director Basil Joseph is confirmed — and it's not Shaktimaan.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is deep into shooting SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore mega-production 'Varanasi' in Hyderabad alongside Mahesh Babu, and was spotted savoring local mangoes between takes. She's also confirmed for Krrish 4 with Hrithik Roshan.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun is in talks for a Hollywood debut with Mortal Kombat producer Lawrence Kasanoff. His father David Dhawan got emotional at the 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' trailer launch, saying 'every parent deserves a son like Varun.'

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is juggling two mega-budget films — Allu Arjun's 'Raaka' and SRK's 'King' — using body doubles for action sequences while managing her pregnancy. She also exited Kalki 2, replaced by Sai Pallavi.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' teaser dropped on his birthday (May 20) and clocked a record-breaking 64 million YouTube views in 24 hours. He shed 15 kg in four months to play an assassin in the Prashanth Neel-directed epic.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali continues to earn praise as an emotional, timeless Partition love story. He recently appeared on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon and reflected on the Komagata Maru history.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina's fans are buzzing over viral photos with her and Vicky Kaushal's newborn son, while she's been sharing pregnancy updates and family moments. OTT launches and new film projects are also in her pipeline for June 2026.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic drama 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya opened at ₹3.31 crore and is getting a BOGO push on May 25 as its emotional Gen-Z love story resonates with college-going audiences.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi features in the high-energy 'Hellallallo' promo from Ram Charan's 'Peddi,' grooving alongside Shruti Haasan. The sports drama releases June 4 with a record-breaking 3-hour-9-minute runtime.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shut down rumors about requesting cuts in her film 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups,' calling them 'absolute nonsense.' She also shared a heartwarming photo of her baby daughter with Sidharth Malhotra.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena shared family vacation photos and celebrated son Taimur's Taekwondo achievement while continuing to juggle her 'Spirit' project alongside Prabhas. Her pool party pics also went viral this week.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to play the female lead opposite Vicky Kaushal in the mythological drama 'Mahavatar.' She remains India's second most-followed person on Instagram, having surpassed even PM Modi.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's leaked Cocktail 2 song 'Tujhko' was pulled from platforms, sparking fan speculation. She also revealed a fierce, blood-soaked first look for her upcoming film 'Mysaa' and is reuniting with Vijay Deverakonda in 'Rana Baali.'

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is producing and starring in 'Maa Inti Bangaram' with Gulshan Devaiah making his Telugu debut. Her comeback after the myositis battle continues to inspire fans across industries.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's directorial debut 'Krrish 4' remains stuck in a VFX disagreement with YRF over whether to use a Hollywood VFX partner. He also had to debunk yet another viral celebrity death hoax this week.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed a grand live concert in Bhopal on May 23 for the 'Peddi' song launch, mesmerizing crowds with the 'Hellallallo' track. He also praised Hans Zimmer's collaboration on the upcoming ₹4,000 crore Ramayana film.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' is still awaiting CBFC certification, with producer Venkat Narayana saying the release date will be announced once clearance arrives. Fans hoped it would ride Vijay's political momentum as Tamil Nadu CM.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya has upcoming US concert dates for 'The Unstoppable Tour' including Boston in September, and recently contributed a patriotic track for Salman Khan's 'Battle of Galwan.' Fans are buzzing over her TIME Person of the Year mention.
